Hệ thống hút chân không nhà vệ sinh

Indicates the operational status of the vacuum system in aircraft lavatories, essential for the proper flushing and sanitation of toilets during flight.

Definition

Indicates the operational status of the vacuum system in aircraft lavatories, essential for the proper flushing and sanitation of toilets during flight.

Operational example

Cabin crew, please confirm if the lavatory vacuum system is operational before departure.
